messages:
ryan-sales: Heads up — gov-fintech POC in azure-gov-west hit model availability + rate limit errors. Need quick sync to give customer next steps.
nina-se: They pinned `mistral-13b-v0` in their private VNet. Errors are either `model_not_available_in_region` or intermittent 429s depending on which control plane route hits.
omar-rt: Sample log: 
```
2026-03-19T09:12:01Z ERR id=xyza123 status=429 scope=region model=mistral-13b-v0
2026-03-19T09:12:02Z ERR id=xyza124 status=410 reason=model_deprecated
```
tess-eng: Confirmed our HF build for that pin was retired from gov images last month. We didn't block pins, so pinned requests are trying retired runtime.
ryan-sales: Customer policy forbids cross-region model execution for POC. Options they asked for: 1) a gov-compatible variant in-region, or 2) Dedicated/reserved pool quote and lead time.
jen-ps: We have a `mistral-13b-compat-2026` in gov registry. Quality looks ok from quick eval but quant path increases latency. Omar, can you validate no cross-region artifact access?
omar-rt: Verified: compat image and artifacts are staged in gov repo. No plaintext artifacts leave the customer's VNet when runtime runs in their private pool. I ran a 30s 40rps check; no 429s and responses were consistent.
tess-eng: Ops fix: add opt-in pin-fallback flag for private VNet customers so deprecated pins map to compat variant locally. Will require security signoff. Config prototype: `pin_fallback: {mode: "compat", audit: true}`. Infra-bot: deploy patch queued to staging.
infra-bot: [notice] 2026-03-19T10:05:00Z Patch queued: staging routing -> map deprecated pins to compat variant (opt-in).
ryan-sales: Great. Need by EOD: 1) written KMS/VNet implications for legal, 2) pricing delta Dedicated vs compat-in-region, 3) opt-in enabled in staging and rollback plan.
nina-se: KMS note (short): "For Azure Gov: must use customer-managed keys in Azure Key Vault gov tier; provide service principal with unwrap rights; configure private endpoint. We'll send exact checklist."
jen-ps: Pricing stub: compat fallback = hosted token rates + minor integration fee. Dedicated reserved baseline (1 node equiv) = ballpark $55-70k/mo, depends on SLA and burst.
omar-rt: I can flip compat for the POC now if we get customer opt-in. No cross-region routing unless they explicitly allow it.
tess-eng: I'll prepare PR to enable opt-in flag in prod after sec reviews. Rollback: remove flag and route pins to error with guidance.
ryan-sales: OK assembling a short one-pager to send: fallback option, KMS checklist, pricing stub, and opt-in instructions. ETA 16:30 PST. Thanks everyone.
